name: consensus-vote-protocol-v1
description: Multi-model consensus gate: MoE routing, rubric-driven arbitration, multi-turn reflection.

steps.name: provenance-init
steps.prompt_template: Create a new Claim provenance node for: claim_id={{input.claim_id}}, claim_text={{input.claim_text}}. Return claim_id.

steps.name: complexity-router
steps.prompt_template: Analyze claim complexity: {{input.claim_text}}. If trivial, output TRIVIAL. If complex (requires MoE consensus), output COMPLEX.

steps.name: vote-deep-reasoning
steps.prompt_template: CONSENSUS VOTE — DEEP REASONING BACKEND. Route: {{complexity_route}}. If TRIVIAL, output SKIPPED. Else evaluate claim: {{input.claim_text}}. Return structured JSON: agent, model, verdict, confidence.

steps.name: vote-large-model
steps.prompt_template: CONSENSUS VOTE — LARGE MODEL BACKEND. Route: {{complexity_route}}. If TRIVIAL, output SKIPPED. Else evaluate claim: {{input.claim_text}}. Return structured JSON: agent, model, verdict, confidence.

steps.name: debate-reflection
steps.prompt_template: Review collected votes: {{input}}. If SKIPPED, output TRIVIAL_REACHED. If consensus is reached, output 'CONSENSUS_REACHED'. Otherwise, output updated reflection.

steps.name: arbiter-rubric-decision
steps.prompt_template: Evaluate claim: {{input.claim_text}}. Debate summary: {{debate_summary}}. Apply strict Prometheus 2 Rubric (Relevance, Correctness, Neutrality, Evidence). Output final arbiter decision JSON.
